waec.name: WAEC WASSCE (Nigeria)
waec.notes: The 2026 WAEC Nigeria timetable shows subject-specific Objective and Essay papers, with practical/oral papers for some subjects. Durations vary by subject, so this platform uses the official timetable as the structural reference rather than forcing one duration on every course.

neco.name: NECO SSCE (Nigeria)
neco.notes: The 2026 NECO timetables show Objective and Essay papers and, where applicable, Practical, Alternative-to-Practical, Theory & Practice, or Orals papers. Durations vary by subject.

nerdc.notes: NERDC is the curriculum reference for Nigerian JSS subject coverage. The platform should describe its catalogue as Nigeria-aligned unless a course is directly verified against the current official curriculum.

questionPolicy.sourceOfTruth: Questions must test concepts taught in the platform lesson notes. External sources are used to verify curriculum and assessment structure; copyrighted past-question banks are not copied wholesale.

moduleTest.purpose: Test the lessons in the current module

finalExam.purpose: Test concepts across the whole course
